title: A timed-out run whose recall client ignores abort can resume later and start precision requests after its fail
text: A timed-out run whose recall client ignores abort can resume later and start precision requests after its failure record was returned; this overlaps later runs and emits stale model calls/logs. Check the aborted signal after awaited work before starting precision or publishing results.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in d0a6afc, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
